title: lithospermum rosmarinifolium
intro: Lithospermum rosmarinifolium, commonly known as Gromwell or Blue Stone Clover, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae). This perennial herb is native to Europe, North Africa, and parts of Asia, and is valued for its medicinal properties and health benefits. The plant is used to treat various conditions, including inflammation, skin issues, and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Lithospermum rosmarinifolium include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
